claim: Google OAuth login is broken because the client id is the literal placeholder 'YOUR_CLIENT_ID.apps.googleusercontent.com'; authorize and token-exchange requests will be rejected by Google. There is no working client id in the login path.

On mobile, cancelled downloads become invisible: they are removed from active lists as terminal, persisted to history, but HistoryDownloadsTab only renders completedDownloads + failedDownloads, so cancelled items never appear. Desktop history shows them.

DownloadItemCard's fixed 136px height can clip or overflow when a failed item shows a long title (2 lines) plus an error line, because the layout must fit title + badge row + progress + error inside a hard-coded height.

After the user dismisses the authentication dialog, any later VideoProvider notify while the same error is still set re-opens the dialog, because the guard only tracks whether a dialog is currently open, not whether this error was already acknowledged.
